overview: A multi-cloud SecOps platform with automated remediation playbooks, threat intelligence enrichment, and compliance reporting across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
features: Block IP, Isolate Resource, and Revoke IAM Credentials playbooks with dry-run mode
Threat intelligence enrichment using AbuseIPDB, VirusTotal, and MITRE ATT&CK
Known malicious IP auto-flagging from Emerging Threats blocklist
On-demand security reports (Security Posture, Compliance, Incident Summary, Threat Intel) with CSV export
Reports library page with download and email delivery configuration
OWASP-hardened backend with full audit trail and input validation
Real-time dashboard with risk score gauge, provider cards, correlated incidents, and quick actions
